title: fix(formula,lint): a date-arithmetic verdict in a flow condition says the run fails, not that the value reads null
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgPpByBofWLd4fRXKHA6v8SN)_
domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca5BRUDW37pk8jE1gW

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：流程条件(起始条件、连线条件、decision 分支)里对日期字段做加减(如 `close_date + 1 > 3`、`end_date - start_date > duration("1h")`)，判词不再说「字段静默得到 null」，而是如实说明：条件出错时运行在此失败、流程要做的事没做。记录触发流程(及扫描本对象的定时相对触发)上说「运行失败」；其它流程(API、定时、动作或父流程启动)上说「只要这个名字在运行时拿到的是日期，运行就失败」。四个新拒绝码承载这两种句子。
- **为什么改**：#29953 / #30015 已让文本、布尔比较的判词说真话，日期判词被落下。引擎的 `evaluateCondition` 在每种流程上遇错都抛异常、运行失败，旧句子却告诉作者流程会继续往下走。
- **风险与回滚**：分级不变(日期判词在每个位置本来就是 error)，发布门不收也不放。流程条件上的日期判词改用新码 `date-arithmetic-run-fails` / `-run-may-fail`、`date-text-arithmetic-run-fails` / `-run-may-fail`，按旧码 `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` 识别流程站点的使用方需改认；公式字段、校验规则等 record 范围站点原码原句不动。回滚即 revert，无数据迁移。
- **先看**：`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`(`dateFlowArm` / `dateFlowFault` 两个小函数和 `date-arith` 分支)、`packages/formula/src/expression-refusal.ts`(四个码)、`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`(三种流程 × 三个站点的钉子)。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.test.ts -t 30016`，预期 2 条通过：记录触发、定时、API 三个流程的起始条件、连线条件、decision 分支都报 error 且文案说运行失败、不说 null；record 范围校验规则对照仍说 null。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30016

Clause-②: yes (widening) — four codes join @objectstack/formula's ExpressionRefusalCode (date-arithmetic-run-fails, date-arithmetic-run-may-fail, date-text-arithmetic-run-fails, date-text-arithmetic-run-may-fail) and a flow condition's date verdicts move to them from date-arithmetic / date-text-arithmetic (a consumer keyed to those codes on a flow site re-keys); grading unchanged (error at every site); record-scoped sites keep their code and sentence.
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Measured on `main` at `dfafae81` (after PR #30015, merged 2026-11-04T08:28Z). The `date-arith` branch of `typeSoundnessIssue` and the `fault` arm of `dateTextIssue` served one sentence, "this faults at runtime, so the field silently evaluates to null", at every scope. A `'flattened'` site is a flow condition (lint's flow walk, the engine's registration advisory pass, MCP `flow_condition`), and `dag-traversal.ts` `evaluateCondition` throws on a fault on every flow (ADR-0032 §1c): the run fails at the condition, nothing reads null.

| site | before | now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| flow condition, `faultOutcome: 'run-fails'` (record-triggered start / edge / `decision`; a time-relative sweep of the typed object), `bareNamesUnproven` unset | `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic`, error, "silently evaluates to null" | `date-arithmetic-run-fails` / `date-text-arithmetic-run-fails`, error: "this faults at runtime, and a flow condition that cannot be evaluated fails the run: the flow stops at this condition and the work the flow exists to do is not done (it does not read null)." |
| any other flow condition (no outcome declared, or `bareNamesUnproven`) | the same | `date-arithmetic-run-may-fail` / `date-text-arithmetic-run-may-fail`, error: "this faults wherever `close_date` holds the date (that text) when the condition runs, and a flow condition that cannot be evaluated fails the run: …" |
| `record`-scoped site (formula field, validation rule, display predicate) | `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` | unchanged, code and sentence |

**Why two flow sentences, not one (measured).** On a flow that is not record-triggered the bare name holds what the entrance hands the run (`engine.ts` `celScope` docblock: the inbound hook's request body for `trigger-api`, an action's loaded or `id`-only record, a parent's record, or nothing). Through the built `@objectstack/formula` on this head: `celEngine.evaluate({ dialect: 'cel', source: 'close_date + 1 > 3' }, { extra: { close_date: 5 } })` answers `{ ok: true, value: true }`; with `'2026-01-01'` it faults (cel-js `no such overload` for a dyn string `+ int`). So "this faults at runtime" is not proven there, and a code names one message template (`expression-refusal.ts`, the contract), hence four codes, mirroring `type-mismatch-run-fails` / `type-mismatch-run-may-fail`. The run-fails sentence carries no "the write that fired it still lands" clause: `run-fails` also covers a time-relative sweep, which no write fires.

**Routing.** No new mechanism: `dateFlowArm(scope, faultOutcome, bareNamesUnproven)` reads the hint lint already passes (`faultOutcomeOf`, `bareNamesUnproven` from #30025). The date verdicts read bare names only, so `bareNamesUnproven` downgrades them to `-run-may-fail`; a bare name a flow variable holds (`flowVariables`) is still excluded from typing, as before. Grading stays `error` everywhere. `@objectstack/lint` changes only the fault-outcome ledger's docblock.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: a `PINS` entry for each new code (exact params and message); the flattened pins that used to sit under `date-arithmetic` / `date-text-arithmetic` move to `-run-may-fail` (their schema declares no outcome); the record-scoped pins are untouched. `SWEEP_SCHEMAS` gains the flattened deal schema with `faultOutcome: 'run-fails'` and `SWEEP_SOURCES` a flattened date subtraction, so the sweep reaches all four codes and holds their params to their messages.
- `packages/formula/src/validate.test.ts`: flattened `start_date + 1 > 3` under `run-fails` → `-run-fails`; with no outcome and with `bareNamesUnproven` → `-run-may-fail`; neither says "evaluates to null"; `flowVariables: ['start_date']` → no verdict; control: a record-scoped `fail-closed` rule keeps `date-arithmetic` and its null sentence.
- `packages/formula/src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts`: the flattened case now asserts `-run-may-fail`, plus `-run-fails` under the outcome and `-run-may-fail` under `bareNamesUnproven`.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`: three flows (record-triggered, `schedule`, `type: 'api'`), each with a start condition, an edge condition (date arithmetic) and a `decision` branch (date subtraction): every verdict `error`, the record-triggered one says "this faults at runtime, and a flow condition …", the other two "this faults wherever `close_date` holds …", none "evaluates to null". Control: a record-scoped validation rule's date arithmetic keeps the null sentence.

## Acceptance notes

- **A record-scoped `fail-closed` validation rule still says "silently evaluates to null".** There the fault refuses the write (`rule-validator.ts` `checkPredicate`, the ledger's `fail-closed` row), so the sentence is not true either. The card keeps that sentence and the seat ruled it out of scope; reported as a finding, not fixed here.
- **`type-mismatch-run-fails` on a time-relative sweep says "the write that fired it still lands".** Since PR #30015 the `run-fails` outcome also covers a time-relative sweep of the typed object, which no write fires. Pre-existing, outside this card's date scope; the date sentence here avoids the clause. Reported as a finding.
- **The date verdicts stay errors on flows that are not record-triggered,** where the type-mismatch verdict is a warning because what the run binds is not proven. Grading was ruled unchanged; the `-run-may-fail` sentence states the condition under which the run fails, which is true at that grade.
- **`content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`** is outside the claimed file surface; its two date rows make no flow-specific null claim, so it is left as is.

## Verification

All at head `3eea4f73` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), the commit this PR opens on (`origin/main` merged once).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 58 derived families (re-derived after the merge of `origin/main`, the same 58), each run on this head after a full `turbo run build` (`--filter='!@objectstack/docs'`, VERDICT command-exit 0), all **exit 0**. `--ran`: "58 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Among them `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (exit 0: no semantic entry is required for this move, so none is added), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
